summary: checkout-api experienced a spike in HTTP 5xx responses (~16% over 2 minutes) shortly after deploying version v1.1.0 which introduced a currency context bug causing KeyError exceptions.

timeline.description: Deploy v1.1.0 (Add currency context to pricing) was released.
HTTP 5xx rate began rising, reaching 23 errors in the first 10‑second bucket.
Alert fired: checkout‑api HTTP 5xx rate above 5% (observed 16.23%).

evidence.quote: Observed 859 HTTP 5xx responses among 8795 requests. RSS ranged from 0.0 to 76.5 MiB.

next_steps: Rollback the service to the stable version v1.0.0.
Monitor HTTP 5xx rate after rollback to confirm resolution.
Conduct a code review of the currency context changes to prevent KeyError.
Add unit tests for currency handling logic.

proposed_actions.reason: Recent deploy introduced a bug causing request failures.
Ensure all instances are refreshed after rollback.
